facts.statement: e-Gov records the amendment as in_force (in_force_instrument) as of the evidence date.
Provisions changed (e-Gov old/new text): 第3条の2
The prior version of the enforcement regulation had no Article 3-2; the 2026 order adds a two-paragraph rule for covering shortfalls in accounts for guarantee operations under Act Article 11(1)-(3).
Accounting for guarantee activities specified in Agricultural Credit Guarantee Insurance Act Article 11 items 1-3, not a general change to borrowers' loan eligibility.
Article 3-2 permits (できる) specified reserve drawdowns for current-year and carried-forward deficits; it does not command automatic drawdowns.
The amending instrument's supplementary provisions contain no transitional provision.
Parent Act Article 10(1)/(2) legal basis and the regulation's reference to transfer-in funds require authoritative reconciliation before confirmation.

MAFF's September 18 consultation response states the purpose is stable operation of agricultural credit guarantee insurance and smooth farm financing; it rejected the suggestion that the rule encourages credit tightening.

Agricultural credit guarantee institutions receive express accounting authority to apply reserves and transfers in the specified sequence; farm borrowers do not obtain a new statutory right to guaranteed lending.
